## 🐞 How to Report Bugs

You can report bugs or issues with this package through either of the following channels:

::: panel-tabset
## 📝 Google Form

Prefer a quick and simple option? Submit your report through our feedback form.

👉 [Open the feedback form](https://forms.gle/Sx9c119KskwSiNMG8){.btn .btn-primary}

## 🐙 GitHub Issues

Recommended for users familiar with GitHub, as it allows you to track the status of your report.

👉 [Open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/xavierclementegarcia/admetshiny-package/issues){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

::: callout-tip
## 📋 Tips for a useful bug report

To help us resolve the issue faster, please include:

- A **clear description** of the problem
- The **steps to reproduce** it
- Your **R version** and **operating system**
- Any **error messages** or screenshots
:::

::: callout-note
## 💡 Suggestions are welcome

Have an idea to improve ADMETShiny? You can also reach us by [e-mail](mailto:xgarcia@unicauca.edu.co).
:::
